A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' [[Coruscanti/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was the third [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of the [[Republic Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Elin Garza]]. The two were married sometime after her previous husband [[Joron Tal'vor]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[3671 BBY]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but their marriage was later annulled. The name of Garza's husband was also classified under what her fellows considered mysterious circumstances.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elin Garza's husband was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
